title: Version 1.86.0
body:
Version 1.86.0 (⚒️Quality of Life Update👷)

💡 New Spotlight

Ever wanted to make your base look extra special? Well now you can with the spotlight! It creates an awesome beam effect.


You can find the spotlight at Illumine Designs

🗺️ Minimap Cave Layers

The minimap now supports CAVE LAYERS. This should make it easier to navigate those pesky caves


The minimap's extra details menu is now hidden by default as well

Semi Truck Improvements

We made a LOT of changes to the semi truck. it now has thicker walls, and can no longer unanchor items when flipping


The Upgrade of the Semi Truck now costs $25,000 We understand that before it was too pricey for players. No refunds :)

🔴 Raw Adurite Location

Weunderstand that the Raw Adurite vein was seemingly impossilbe for a lot of players, and as a result, we moved it to Magma Cave

🥚 The Hatch - Coming July 2nd

Just a reminder that Oaklands will be participating in The Hatch event on July 2nd, we hope to see you there!

🐛Bug Fixes

Loading your property will now create an invisible collision box on the cilent. This should stop you from falling through the floor alongside your items falling through. Still investigating why this happens though.



Scaffolding & Tall Scaffolding will no longer fling around when you drag it


Placing wire placeables will no longer let you go over the limit mlindly, it will now prevent you ftom doing so

👋 That's all for now!

Enjoy the update!
